scope: Static reference and exposure-path audit only. No secret value, secret file, environment value, process argv, or credential-bearing log was read.
verdict: API-key and runtime-secret handling has partial typed governance but no complete inventory, posture probe, lifecycle telemetry, or SOC correlation.

canonical_governance_present.law: references name a locator but never secret material
canonical_governance_present.runtime_class: RuntimeMachineIdentity is the only allowed steady-state class

coverage_gaps: does not include kernel node-control API credential
does not include node websocket/dog credential
does not include CYNIC_CHAT_API_KEY or backend API credentials
does not include Forgejo token or artifact-store credential
does not assess ownership, mode, group, symlink policy, expiry, rotation, consumer identity, or process argument exposure
secret_exposed is hard-coded false rather than produced by a bounded exposure observer

reference_inventory.consumer: cynic-node runtime supervision and kernel WebSocket
cynic-inference chat endpoint and OpenAI-compatible adapter

observed_design_risks.finding: The existing secret-presence report cannot detect exposure: secret_exposed is always false.
observed_design_risks.required_control: Separate bounded exposure-posture observer over declared service metadata; classify argv/env/log/config exposure without emitting material.

observed_design_risks.finding: Node runtime configuration resolves API keys into String fields, and federation runtime config retains an API key String.
observed_design_risks.required_control: Replace broad runtime secret strings at public/internal configuration boundaries with a non-serializable secret handle or narrowly scoped authenticated-client construction; retain only SecretReference in read-backs.

observed_design_risks.finding: API-key presence coverage covers only storage and Proxmox; node, chat, backend, Forgejo, and artifact identities are absent from the producer catalog.
observed_design_risks.required_control: Registry-backed SecretPresenceSpec catalog with consumer, permitted provider, secret class, rotation policy, and expected ownership/mode policy.

observed_design_risks.finding: Environment variables are accepted as operational API-key sources; process environment exposure and systemd manager visibility are not assessed per consumer.
observed_design_risks.required_control: Per-service provider policy: environment only where explicit and bounded; file/OS credential store preference for persistent service identity; observer records provider form and permission posture only.

observed_design_risks.finding: No expiry, rotation due, revocation state, last-successful-use, or authentication-failure telemetry exists for API-key identities.
observed_design_risks.required_control: Secret lifecycle samples and alert rules without values: present, class-valid, provider-valid, ownership-valid, rotation_due, auth_failure_count, last_use_at, and exposure_posture.

observed_design_risks.finding: NET-SEC-001 already demonstrated secret material in process argv on storage, while this audit surface cannot correlate it to the owning identity or incident.
observed_design_risks.required_control: SOC security-event producer with redaction verification, dedupe by identity/consumer/exposure channel, alert transition, rotation action requirement, and post-rotation read-back.

safety_invariants: No secret value, length, digest, prefix, suffix, entropy measurement, locator path, environment value, or raw argv may enter a metric, alert, incident, or evidence report.
A secret existence check is not a secret exposure check.
An exposure posture unavailable to the observer is unobservable, never safe.
Runtime steady state must not depend on HumanAdmin or MachineEnrollment material.
An alert may propose rotation/remediation but never read, print, or mutate a credential without an explicit bounded secret-rotation capability and post-action read-back.
next_lowest_layer: Extend the canonical protocol SecretReference family with lifecycle/posture contracts; then extend cynic-host secret_presence through injected metadata-only observers. Do not add a dashboard or a CLI-owned policy table first.
